flags.guidance: MOM lists working arrangements (daily working hours, working days per week, rest day) as item 6.
MOM lists fixed deductions as item 10.
MOM lists other salary-related components, such as bonuses and incentives, as item 13.
MOM lists the types of leave (annual, outpatient sick, hospitalisation, maternity, childcare) as item 14.
MOM lists other medical benefits (insurance, medical, dental) as item 15. TAFEP says offers should set out key terms such as benefits.
MOM lists place of work as an optional item 18 and strongly encourages including it, used if the work location differs from the employer's address.
TAFEP says candidates should get sufficient time and opportunity to clarify and consider the terms and conditions of the offer before acceptance. TAFEP gives no number of days.
